info.title: ClearCall media-processing-service API
info.description: Uploads call recordings, tracks transcription and AI analysis, and records compliance-officer reviews. Roles come from the service's own user table, not from the token. Workflow rules, ownership and the dashboard definitions are written up in docs/API.md.

tags.name: Dashboard
tags.description: Org-wide compliance figures; unlike /api/media-assets they cover every user's uploads

tags.name: Advisors
tags.description: Advisors a call can be attributed to

tags.name: Media assets
tags.description: Uploaded recordings, their AI analysis and officer review

tags.name: Uploads
tags.description: Two-step upload: get presigned S3 URLs here, then PUT the file bytes to each URL

tags.name: Observability
tags.description: Production AI-quality metrics for the developer dashboard

put.description:
Uploader only. Send only the items you disagree with: an empty overrides list accepts the AI verdicts. Each submission replaces the previous one; unchanged overrides are not logged again and dropped ones are logged as a revert to the AI verdict.

**Roles:** SUPER_ADMIN, ADMIN, COMPLIANCE_OFFICER

400.description: Unknown or duplicate item, invalid decision, or decision equal to the AI verdict

404.description: Asset not found, or not yours

409.description: AI analysis is not ready for review

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired token, or the account is disabled

get.description:
All users, newest first.

**Roles:** ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired token, or the account is disabled

post.description:
Creates a Cognito login and a matching user row. The password is set permanently to DEFAULT_USER_PASSWORD and no invite email is sent. Only SUPER_ADMIN can create ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN.

**Roles:** ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

403.description: Caller may not create that role

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired token, or the account is disabled

post.description: Public. Creates the first account as SUPER_ADMIN in both Cognito and the database. Refused with 403 as soon as any user exists.

The whole request is validated before anything is written, so one bad file means no URLs are issued. The returned id is the media asset id used by every other endpoint; PUT the bytes with the same Content-Type you declared before expiresIn runs out.

**Roles:** SUPER_ADMIN, ADMIN, COMPLIANCE_OFFICER

400.description: Content type, extension, size or file count not allowed; advisor unknown or inactive; or batch mode without a batch bucket

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired token, or the account is disabled

patch.description:
The Cognito login is updated before the database. You cannot change your own status or disable the last active ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN.

**Roles:** ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

409.description: Self-change, or it would disable the last active ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired token, or the account is disabled

patch.description:
Also moves the user to the matching Cognito group. Only SUPER_ADMIN can grant ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN; you cannot change your own role or leave the system without an active ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN.

**Roles:** ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN

403.description: Caller may not grant that role

409.description: Self-change, or it would leave no active ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired token, or the account is disabled

get.description:
On a caller's first request the user row is created first.

**Roles:** any authenticated user

decision.description: PASS, FAIL, PARTIAL, CANNOT_DETERMINE or NOT_APPLICABLE; must differ from the AI verdict.

overrides.description: Only the items the reviewer disagrees with. An empty list accepts every AI verdict.

processing_mode.description: immediate | batch. Defaults to immediate when omitted.

result.description: Raw fyp-ai output, passed through unchanged. Null unless analysisStatus is READY.
